_why: KT-372 — the bridge resolves a mention into typed targets; the backend routes
on those targets. Both sides had green suites while the 2026-08-21 incident
happened between them: the bridge correctly resolved `@claude` to the native
agent, and the backend correctly delivered to the native agent. Nobody was
wrong, and the intended session never woke.
This file is the contract they share. The Python suite asserts the bridge
EMITS exactly this for each case; the Rust integration test feeds the same
payload to the router and asserts who is woken. A change on either side that
does not match the other breaks a test rather than a room.

cases.name: an_unknown_rank_never_degrades_to_the_native_agent
refusal_mentions: does not identify a joined CLI
